reviewer: Codex coding agent, visual source-rendition review; no human review claimed
method: Inspected all 182 physical PDF page images in 46 source-labeled sheets, at 1600x2400 pixels; checked fields, printed dollar amounts, line-item counts, header roles, row associations, text wrapping and page continuations. PyMuPDF presence is an unscored cross-check. No evaluated parser output was used. This is agent qualification of controlled synthetic templates, not independently human-adjudicated real invoice truth.
